# Vincent Lu

> Personal website of Vincent Lu, a project manager in Utrecht focused on digital delivery and adoption. Selected work and writing about AI, work and life between China and the Netherlands.

## Pages

- [About](https://vincentluting.github.io/about/): where I come from, what I like doing, and things I made
- [Work](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/): case studies from digital delivery, data products and process improvement
- [Blog](https://vincentluting.github.io/posts/): notes on AI, work and living between China and the Netherlands

## Stories from work

- [Helping three game studios adopt central IT services](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/tencent-studios/): Tencent, 2023 – 2024
- [From one reporting request to four dashboards for Philips](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/philips-amazon-marketing-cloud/): Philips via OMD, 2021 – 2023
- [Building web tools for Amazon’s catalog team](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/amazon-vendor-tickets/): Amazon, 2019 – 2021

## Things I made

- [Deep Dive](https://vincentluting.github.io/#deep-dive): a career exploration product designed for my MBA thesis, with a demo and research notes
